description.text: The aim of this program is to provide our future international students withthe opportunity to improve your study and language skills before starting anundergraduate program at NUAA.This program provides international students with a pathway to NUAA'Sundergraduate degree. Students interested in beginning their educationalcareer in the spring of 2022 are encouraged to apply. You will spend six monthslearning the basics for your desired degree program together with Chineseimmersion program.

duration.text: The Foundation Programs at Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1166 USD/per semester ￥ 8400 CNY/per semester

materials.text: Copy of your passportHighest Academic Degree Certificate (Notarized copy)Highest Academic Transcript Certificate (Notarized copy)Health Certificate (From a certified hospital signed by the physicianand stamped)English Language Proficiency Certificate (not mandatory)

requirements.text: Non-Chinese NationalAll applicants must be in good healthUnder the age of 24 (Foundation Program)High School Graduate (Final year high school student can also apply)Proficient in English (Able to take courses in English medium)
